has made wrong. Rewrite only the words that are now wrong. Everything the

Answer with edits. Each edit quotes a span of the section exactly as it is
written, line breaks included, and gives the text to put in its place. Quote
only the words that are wrong, and no more of the words around them than it

that sentence. Never quote the whole section: an edit that replaces all of it is
a rewrite, and is refused. Write replacements in the section's own voice: its

Documentation section docs/shelves.md#Shelves > Listing titles:

`Shelf.titles()` returns the titles on the shelf, sorted alphabetically. Pass
`sort=False` to get them in the order they were added.

The chunk bookshelf/shelves.py::Shelf.titles before the change:

def titles(self, sort=True):
    found = [book.title for book in self._books]
    return sorted(found) if sort else found

And after it:

def titles(self):
    return sorted((book.title for book in self._books))

What the change made wrong: `Shelf.titles()` no longer accepts a `sort=False` argument, so the documented way to get insertion order is now wrong.
